dimension: thesis_latex/body_main_short.tex (whole body) plus the Abstract and Kurzfassung in thesis_latex/Thesis_short.tex: every sentence, table cell, caption and footnote whose number or wording derives from the single-instance crystal reference
summary: Read both files in full (876 + 240 lines). The single-instance convention reaches 90+ sites in the body and 9 in the Abstract/Kurzfassung. Numbers I could re-derive from the nearest-copy CSV reproduce the printed reference values to the digit (Table 5: 111/198/199, 103/167/169, 55/80/80, gains +87/+64/+25 with Wilson 23.9-34.0/16.9-26.1/5.7-11.9; McNemar 0.509/7.6e-4/0.009/0.011; Newcombe +2.6 [-4.2,+9.4] via the thesis's own stats_utils; MDE 9.8 pp on 112 discordant; 90% interval -3.1..+8.3 = 'about eight points'; 62.7% rank-1 near-site trim = 190/303; 6,169 near-site poses; 311/1,622/466/302 qualifying poses over 199/169/80/202 complexes; pooled 4 A reach 98.0%), so their nearest-copy counterparts are exact: rank-1 49.2/43.6/18.8%, top-15 70.3/59.1/27.4%, top-30 70.6/60.4/27.4%; gains +64 (+21.1, Wilson 16.9-26.1) / +47 (+15.5, 11.9-20.0) / +26 (+8.6, 5.9-12.3); 15->30 +1/+4/+0 (b=4,c=0 p=0.125, no star); AutoDock-DiffDock +5.6 pp [-1.7,+12.8], exact McNemar p=0.159, 129 discordant (73/56), MDE 10.5 pp, observed power 0.32, 90% interval -0.5..+11.7 ('about twelve points', TOST margin 11.7); top-5 contrast is IDENTICAL under both conventions (88/48, +13.2 [+5.7,+20.4], p_holm 7.6e-4); top-15 +11.2 [+3.9,+18.4] p_holm 0.004; top-30 +10.2 [+3.0,+17.3] p_holm 0.008; Cochran Q p 2e-17 to 2e-29; validity gate removes at most FIVE complexes (DiffDock rank-1 137->132), not four; rank-1 failures with no qualifying pose 57.8%/70.2%/89.4% (was 54.2/67.0/89.9); raw exh128 arm 42.9%/65.3%/71.6% at d=1/15/30 (was 31.0/61.1/66.7), gnina-vs-raw rank-1 disc 39/20 exact p=0.018 (was 0.040); Table 1 near-nativeness blocks for the five re-scored arms (e.g. AutoDock+gnina 217 comp / 451 poses / 5.0%, DiffDock+smina 186/2,169/24.1%, EquiBind+gnina 86/515/5.7%); qualifying poses 442/2,068/483 (Vina-only 431) over 214/183/83 (217); AutoDock median qualifying poses per succeeding complex rises from 1 to 2; 4 A any-pose reach AutoDock 92.4%, DiffDock 90.1%, pooled 99.7% (302/303); near-site PB-valid top-15 pool 6,169 -> 7,566; rank-1 near-site trim 62.7% -> 82.2%. Everything resting on Kabsch form (needs a per-copy Kabsch that the CSV lacks), the triple selection gate, cluster-level reach (Table 6, Figs 5-6), interaction fingerprints (Fig 7, Table 7, :489-:532), cost medians/IQRs/Friedman, Fig 4 bootstraps, and the five arms not re-scored (diffdock_gnina, equibind_unguided_smina, three raw EquiBind arms) is 'recompute'. Wording must change at the Methods definition (:109, :113, :115, :119, :124-133, :158, :165, :170), Table 5 lead-in (:326), Fig 2/3 captions, the cost definition (:708), and a new Limitations sentence (:868); the Abstract needs 5 number swaps and one wording decision, the Kurzfassung 5 swaps of which only the CI grows by one character on an already full page.

decisions.question: Is the variant selection (triple gate PB-valid & <=2 A & Kabsch <=1 A at top-15, :191-:199, :781, :866) re-run under nearest-copy or frozen at the single-instance selection?
options: Re-run selection under nearest-copy and accept that the DiffDock refiner (133 vs 132) may flip to gnina, which changes the DiffDock* arm everywhere including the Orai panels
Freeze the selection, state at :191 that variants were selected under the single-instance convention, and report all downstream numbers under nearest-copy
decisions.recommendation: Re-run it, because a thesis that reports under one convention and selects under another invites the same examiner objection twice; if DiffDock flips, the whole DiffDock arm must be re-scored (diffdock_gnina is not among the six re-scored arms)

decisions.question: Do the interaction-fingerprint metrics (:165, :481-:532, Fig 7, Table 7) follow the nearest copy?
options: Profile every deposited copy, compare each pose to its nearest copy with chain-agnostic residue keys (full consistency, largest effort, new canonicalisation code)
Exempt the interaction analysis and say so explicitly at :165 and :481 (poses recovering an alternate copy keep scoring zero overlap)
Restrict the interaction analysis to poses whose nearest copy is the reference and disclose the reduced cohort
decisions.recommendation: Option 1 if the plan truly means 'every crystal-referenced metric'; otherwise option 2 with an explicit exemption sentence, because option 3 changes cohorts silently

decisions.question: Which copy supplies the Kabsch form partner (:124-:133, Table 1 Form block, :396, :404, Fig 3)?
options: The copy that minimises the in-place RMSD for that pose
The copy that minimises the Kabsch RMSD independently
decisions.recommendation: The in-place-nearest copy, so the placement^2 = in-place^2 - form^2 decomposition at :133 stays per-copy consistent

decisions.question: How to phrase the 'about six in ten rank-1 failures contain no qualifying pose' clause (Abstract :63, Kurzfassung :95, body :406, :788, :857) now that the shares are 57.8% (AutoDock) and 70.2% (DiffDock)?
options: Keep 'about six in ten' (accurate for AutoDock only)
'six to seven in ten' in English and 'sechs bis sieben von zehn' in German (+11 characters on a Kurzfassung page with zero slack, requires a compensating cut)
Drop the pooled phrase and give both shares
decisions.recommendation: Option 2, and pay for it in the Kurzfassung by trimming elsewhere on the same page; the CI at :94 already grows by one character

decisions.question: Does the metal-adjacent stratum (:88, :868, 78 of 303) follow the nearest copy?

Both silent, disclosure only in Methods and Limitations
